name: Rewilding Innovation Fund
summary: Grants of up to £15,000 for Rewilding Network projects in Britain, covering 40+ hectares or any marine project, to fund plans, feasibility work, community engagement, expertise and technology. Capital works are excluded.
reporting: Supported projects report on their progress every quarter and share stories and lessons learnt with the Rewilding Network and the public.

steps: Join the Rewilding Network, if not a member
Pitch to the steering group, if shortlisted

eligibility.rule: Is a member of the Rewilding Network
Rewilds at scale: more than 40 hectares of land or any size of marine project
Shows understanding of and commitment to the rewilding principles
Demonstrates why funding is needed now and cannot be accessed from other sources
Has not previously received Innovation Fund money for the same piece of work
Funding not used for land purchase or capital costs such as fencing

calls.label: Next round

status.quote: Complete the application form for the Rewilding Innovation Fund when the next round is open.

recurring.quote: We currently have two rounds per year, typically one in the summer and one at new year.

calls.recurring: Two rounds a year, typically summer and new year

applicant_types.quote: You're a member of the Rewilding Network. This includes, but is not limited to, community, private and public landowners and managers of rewilding areas on the land and sea.

geography.quote: based in Britain (England, Wales and Scotland)

access.quote: Complete the application form for the Rewilding Innovation Fund when the next round is open.

window.quote: Projects have two opportunities to apply for funding through the Rewilding Innovation Fund each year, in the new year and summer.

amount.quote: Funding for up to £15,000* will be considered. We expect the majority of grants to be less than £10,000.

consortium_required.quote: This can be an individual landholding/organisation or a cluster of landholdings/organisations.

reporting.quote: All supported projects must measure and report on their progress every quarter. All successful applicants must agree to share stories and lessons learnt for the wider Rewilding Network and for the public.

effort.quote: Ensure that you are a Rewilding Network member. If you aren’t, please apply to become a Rewilding Network member before you make your funding application.
Complete the application form for the Rewilding Innovation Fund when the next round is open.
Shortlisted projects will be invited to pitch their project to the steering group in a 10-minute online presentation.

eligibility.quote: You're a member of the Rewilding Network.
You're rewilding at scale* - that is more than 40 hectares of land or any size of marine project.
You show an understanding of and commitment to working to our rewilding principles - whether you are at the beginning of your rewilding journey or have been carrying out this work for some time.
You can demonstrate why you need funding/intervention now, and why you cannot access this funding from other sources.
You haven't previously been awarded money from the Rewilding Innovation Fund (previously known as the Incubator Fund) for the same piece of work.
Funding cannot be provided for land purchase or capital costs such as fencing.

after_award.quote: All supported projects must measure and report on their progress every quarter.
